blurb: Embark on a powerful journey through history at the Irish American Museum. Step inside and discover the incredible story of Irish immigrants who journeyed across the Atlantic during the Great Hunger. Through the meticulously preserved home of James and Sarah Feeley, you'll gain a vivid understanding of their journey and the new life they built in a vibrant city.But their story is just the beginning.
